events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Your cancellation fee is being refunded in full: $6.61, paid to you as a Ryde voucher.

What decided it: your driver cancelled the trip, and while he marked himself as arrived, the location records show he was still a few hundred metres from the pickup point and never reached it during the trip. He also never waited the required few minutes there after marking arrived. Your messages showed you were waiting at the pickup point.

You don't need to do anything — the voucher will be applied to your account. Nothing else about your account changes.

DRIVER: Your account is being sent to Ryde for review.

What prompted it: you cancelled this trip after marking yourself as arrived, but the location records show you were several hundred metres from the pickup point and didn't reach it at all, and the trip didn't include the required wait time there after that arrival mark. Your statement that you waited at the pickup isn't supported by those records, and the rider's messages show they were at the pickup point.

The reviewer will look at the arrival mark, the location and trip records, the wait time, and the messages. No outcome has been decided yet.

Because the rider was charged, the $6.61 cancellation fee is being returned to them as a voucher. No action is needed from you right now.
